name: bead_strands
description: blue glowing strands strung with bead bubbles, every hole of the set a glass bead with a bright rim, on violet black
notes: Added: nothing new to the engine; the map bead_strands (violet black, indigo, periwinkle, to ice blue at its top), every hole a glass bead: an inverted `inside` glow at power 6 and a light domed on `inside`, its highlight the map's periwinkle at 0.85.

Lessons: item 037 brought five references whose look is a glowing lace web of fine strands pierced by round holes of every size (devilfish, dreaming, dragon-mail, flamed, deepsea-life, all -25.jpg), and they went in as **four on one stack; bead_strands adds an inside rim glow and the bead light**. **The holes are the set's interior**, and the galleries have none to offer: a hole probe (the interior white, the rest black) read 0.000 on every Julia seat of a 60-seat scout, and of 150 plane seats only phoenix-classic held interior, which reads as whirls. So the seats are hand-placed Julia sets of z^d + c at the centre of a hyperbolic component (Newton on f^p(0) = 0), whose Fatou components are round discs at every scale: whole sets and the framings where holes of many sizes meet; the pinwheels at a repelling fixed point have holes too big. **Strands that hug the set**: the stripe average's crests at density 2 and 4 (a glow at power 10, flame_wisp_waves), masked by the inverted `de` (here at power 1.5 and 4), so they feather out of the lace round each hole and die into the ground; 032's strands ignored the set because nothing tied them to it. The ground is the smooth count by rank at gamma 2 to 5, dark, so the strands carry the lace; at gamma 1 the near-set band is one flat cream fill. The interior paint wants pure black on the dark references: the tone pass lifts a dark navy hole to slate. `inside` read as a palette at three cycles is a bullseye in every hole (the `inner` formulation keeps it at 0.12); an inverted `inside` glow at power 16 is invisible, at 6 a soft inner rim, and a `light` on `inside` at one band with `rings` 1 domes each component as a lit glass bead (bead_strands' default, the `bubbles` formulation elsewhere). Round one is drawn at --draft (about 2 s a frame at six threads).
